Revenue Operations Co-op Student

Fairmount Analytics is a workforce services provider. Larkspur Industries is looking for a Revenue Operations Co-op Student to support the joint go-to-market team.

Location: Ottawa, ON

Duration: 4 months
Salary: $26.00 per hour
Application Deadline: 2027-10-15

Responsibilities

- Maintain pipeline management dashboards and quota planning models
